The structure of Li2Tb2 (reduced formula LiTb) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with four atoms in the unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis (CrystalNN) shows both Li and Tb centers in close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors per center atom, at distances of 2.9271–2.9481 Å. This analysis also finds corner-, edge-, and face-sharing contacts among the 12-vertex coordination polyhedra of like centers, and the neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
